payload.story: This 2001 1 rupee coin from India was struck in stainless steel at the Noida mint. The value side shows रुपया (rupee in Hindi) alongside a large 1 and the word RUPEE between grain stalks. Below the numeral sits the year 2001 and the small dot mint mark of the Noida mint. The obverse displays the Ashoka Lion Capital.

items_full.label: C244 · Mexico · 1964 · 20 centavos · MXP

payload.story: This 1964 20 centavos coin from Mexico was struck in brass (95% copper and 5% zinc). The reverse shows the Pyramid of the Sun at Teotihuacan with the volcanoes Popocatépetl and Iztaccíhuatl behind it under a radiant Phrygian cap (cap of liberty). Above the pyramid are a large 20 and the word CENTAVOS, paired with the 1964 date and the Mo mint mark. The obverse displays the Mexican national arms.
